CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Autumn-2021 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Autumn-2021 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 868 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 4 benchmark sites in 3 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: March 2021 to March 2021). These surveys captured 237 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 11 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 759 cards across 68 sites, with 21.7% showing evidence of mouse activity (165 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 290 transects across 68 sites (survey period: March 2021 to April 2021), detecting active burrows in 42.4% of transects (total: 438 active burrows).
